title: Fujiyoshida City - Mt. Fuji (Sunset)
description:
Mount Fuji (富士山) is Japan's highest mountain. The near perfect shaped volcano has been worshipped as a sacred mountain and experienced popularity among artists and common people throughout the centuries.

The wallpaper is a 15 minute long fixed frame shot taken from a hill in Fujiyoshida City, Yamanashi Pref, Japan. The highway is Chuo Expressway Yoshida Line and Fujikyu Line trains occasionally pass by. 

Credit to Yuga's Ambient Works for the footage.
